info.title: Api
info.description:
Sun and Moon from JPL DE440, checked against Skyfield. One endpoint per question: /v1/position (an instant), /v1/track (paths over a window), /v1/day (rise, set, twilight), /v1/crossing (when a body reaches an altitude), /v1/alignment (where to stand so the body sits on a landmark), POST /v1/alignment/search (every pass over an area you can stand in), /v1/sightline (does the line of sight clear), /v1/magnetic (declination), /v1/weather (nearest METAR).

One vocabulary: lat, lon, height, heightRef (you); targetLat, targetLon, targetHeight, targetHeightRef (the landmark); body; time | start, end | date, tz; stepSeconds; temperature, pressure, horizon, horizonProfile, dut1; aim; include. Unknown parameters are rejected. Errors: 400 InvalidRequest names the parameter and what is allowed; 503 Unavailable when a data source fails. Every response carries conventions (every threshold and model used) and provenance.

height.description: Metres above the WGS-84 ellipsoid (same as heightEllipsoid; kept for compatibility).

heightMsl.description: Metres above the EGM96 geoid (≈ mean sea level).

geoidUndulation.description: EGM96 N, metres: heightEllipsoid = heightMsl + geoidUndulation.

heightRef.description: What the request's height was measured from; default = no height given, the observer is on the geoid.

apparentAltitude.description: Refracted altitude, degrees; null when it would lie below the observer's horizon or the refraction model's floor (conventions.refraction.validFrom). CHANGED 2026-10-29: was always a number, and repeated the true altitude below −1°.

altitudeRate.description: d(altitude)/dt, degrees per minute (true altitude; analytic from the DE440 velocity, no finite difference).

azimuthRate.description: d(azimuth)/dt, degrees per minute (symmetric difference over ±10 s).

apparentAltitude.description: Refracted altitude, degrees; null when it would lie below the observer's horizon or the refraction model's floor (conventions.refraction.validFrom). CHANGED 2026-10-29: was always a number, and repeated the true altitude below −1°.

altitudeRate.description: d(altitude)/dt, degrees per minute (true altitude; analytic from the DE440 velocity, no finite difference).

azimuthRate.description: d(azimuth)/dt, degrees per minute (symmetric difference over ±10 s).

brightLimbAngleFromVertical.description: Bright limb seen from this observer: degrees clockwise from the local vertical (the direction towards the zenith) as the observer sees the sky, i.e. towards increasing azimuth; topocentric (phase.brightLimbAngle is geocentric, from celestial north through east). = 360° − (χ − q) with χ the topocentric bright-limb position angle and q the parallactic angle. null at the zenith.

validFrom.description: Lowest apparent altitude that gets a value: max(horizon, the model floor −1.6963°). Below it apparentAltitude is null.

altitude.description: Apparent altitude of the horizon, degrees (null for a profile).

dip.description: Sea-horizon dip, degrees: √(1 − k)·acos(R/(R + heightMsl)), k = terrestrialRefractionK, R = 6 371 008.8 m.

height.description: The eye's height as given (0 with heightRef default when omitted: the eye on the geoid).

encoding.description: Canonical r1 encoding: the cache key part for the region (window GETs carry it).

geoidUndulation.description: EGM96 N over the region's vertices, metres.

time.description: Midpoint of the pass's first entry and last exit; standingPoint and the body's and Sun's values are at this instant.

enter.description: Where and when the standing point crosses into the region (a point on a region edge).

segments.description: Each in-region interval of the ground track, in time order (piers and inlets split a pass).

standingPoint.description: The alignment standing point at `time` (may lie between segments, outside the region); distanceKm to the target.

azimuth.description: The body's (aim point's) azimuth from the standing point, degrees true = the bearing to the target.

apparentAltitude.description: The body's (aim point's) apparent altitude from the standing point = the target's apparent elevation, degrees.

illuminatedFraction.description: The Moon's illuminated fraction, 0–1 (geocentric, as /v1/position), whichever the body (minIlluminated filters on it).

sunAltitude.description: The Sun centre's true altitude from the standing point, degrees (twilight convention −6/−12/−18; maxSunAltitude filters on it).

passes.description: Passes whose first entry lies in [start, end) and that pass the filters, in time order.

reference.description: The region's bbox centre, where the scan looks at the body.

distanceM.description: Nearest and farthest region points from the target, metres (exact WGS-84 geodesics).

elevation.description: The target's apparent elevation over the whole region at the eye height, degrees: the band the body's apparent altitude must be in.

azimuth.description: Forward azimuths from the region to the target, degrees true.

band.description: The same band for the body seen from the reference point, as true altitude, margins included.

cache.description: Workers Caching status of this window's GET (HIT, MISS, …; LOCAL when computed in-process).

counters.description: Summed over the windows computed for this answer (cache hits report the counts of the run that filled them).

targetHeight.description: Height of the point to frame (e.g. the figure's middle), metres; see targetHeightRef.

targetHeightRef.description: What targetHeight is measured from: ellipsoid (default) or msl (EGM96).

items.description: [lon, lat] in degrees (a third element, altitude, is ignored).

anyOf.description: [west, south, east, north], degrees (RFC 7946 bbox order); no antimeridian crossing.

region.description: Where you can stand: a GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon (holes allowed; a Feature wrapping one is accepted) or a bbox. Edges are straight lines in (lon, lat) (RFC 7946 §3.1.1); insideness is even-odd per polygon. At most 1 000 vertices and 100 rings, ≤ 50 km across, ≤ 100 km from the target and not containing it. Coordinates are quantised to 1e-7° (≤ 1.1 cm).

height.description: Eye height wherever you stand, metres; see heightRef. Default: the eye on the geoid (heightMsl 0).

heightRef.description: What height is measured from: ellipsoid (default) or msl, in which case the eye is height + N(P) at every standing point P.

end.description: Passes whose first entry lies in [start, end); at most 400 days.

aim.description: Which point of the disc sits on the target (as /v1/alignment): center (default), upper, lower, litCentroid (Moon).

include.description: Extra context per pass, as on every endpoint: sun (azimuth, true and apparent altitude), phase (the Moon's phase block), or sun,phase.

minIlluminated.description: Keep passes whose Moon illuminated fraction (at the pass time) is at least this, 0–1.

maxSunAltitude.description: Keep passes whose Sun centre true altitude (at the pass time, from the standing point) is at most this, degrees; e.g. −4 for a dark sky.

height.description: Metres above the WGS-84 ellipsoid (same as heightEllipsoid; kept for compatibility).

heightMsl.description: Metres above the EGM96 geoid (≈ mean sea level).

geoidUndulation.description: EGM96 N, metres: heightEllipsoid = heightMsl + geoidUndulation.

heightRef.description: What the request's height was measured from; default = no height given, the observer is on the geoid.

declination.description: Magnetic declination, degrees, east positive. Magnetic bearing = true bearing − declination.

inValidityWindow.description: WMM2025 is valid 2025.0–2030.0; outside it the secular variation is extrapolated.

compass.description: WMM2025's compass zones by horizontal intensity H: blackout (H < 2000 nT, around the dip poles: the declination is unreliable and a compass does not work), caution (2000 ≤ H < 6000 nT: degraded), ok.

sources.description: The data and models this answer comes from (ephemeris, geoid, field model, feed), with versions.

magneticDeclination.description: WMM2025 at the observer, height 0, now; east positive. Full precision (was rounded to 0.01° before 2026-10-29): the same value /v1/magnetic gives for lat/lon now.

observationStale.description: Observation older than 75 minutes (METARs are hourly).

distanceKm.description: Great-circle distance from the observer (sphere of radius 6 371.0088 km).

true.description: Initial great-circle bearing from the observer to the station, degrees true, [0, 360).

magnetic.description: The same bearing, degrees magnetic (true − WMM2025 declination at the observer).

directionDegTrue.description: Direction the wind blows from, degrees true; null when calm or variable.

orMore.description: Reported as N+ (e.g. 10+): at least N.

fetchedAt.description: When this Worker last confirmed the feed with aviationweather.gov (200 or 304).

stale.description: Older than the 60 s fresh window (served while a refresh runs, or because upstream failed).

tier.description: Workers Caching status of the feed fetch, lower-cased cf-cache-status (hit, updating = served stale while it refreshes, miss/expired = fetched from aviationweather.gov, revalidated = 304 from upstream); stale-on-error = the feed fetch failed and this isolate's last copy answered; none = no cache (dev).
